history_aggregate_coverage_values_check.name: history_aggregate_coverage_values_check
history_aggregate_coverage_values_check.value: ("history_aggregate_coverage"."status" = 'AVAILABLE' AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."bucket_count" > 0 AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."first_bucket_at" IS NOT NULL AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."last_bucket_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("history_aggregate_coverage"."status" = 'EXPIRED' AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."bucket_count" = 0 AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."first_bucket_at" IS NULL AND "history_aggregate_coverage"."last_bucket_at" IS NULL)

history_import_jobs_counts_check.name: history_import_jobs_counts_check
history_import_jobs_counts_check.value: "history_import_jobs"."requested_day_count" >= "history_import_jobs"."target_day_count" AND "history_import_jobs"."target_day_count" > 0 AND "history_import_jobs"."completed_day_count" >= 0 AND "history_import_jobs"."successful_day_count" >= 0 AND "history_import_jobs"."failed_day_count" >= 0 AND "history_import_jobs"."skipped_day_count" >= 0 AND "history_import_jobs"."completed_day_count" = "history_import_jobs"."successful_day_count" + "history_import_jobs"."failed_day_count" + "history_import_jobs"."skipped_day_count" AND "history_import_jobs"."completed_day_count" <= "history_import_jobs"."target_day_count"

traffic_direction_profiles_values_check.name: traffic_direction_profiles_values_check
traffic_direction_profiles_values_check.value: ("traffic_direction_profiles"."free_flow_speed_kmh" IS NULL OR "traffic_direction_profiles"."free_flow_speed_kmh" > 0) AND ("traffic_direction_profiles"."maximum_flow_vehicles_per_hour" IS NULL OR "traffic_direction_profiles"."maximum_flow_vehicles_per_hour" > 0)

traffic_lane_observations_value_check.name: traffic_lane_observations_value_check
traffic_lane_observations_value_check.value: ("traffic_lane_observations"."average_speed_kmh" IS NOT NULL AND "traffic_lane_observations"."average_speed_kmh" >= 0) OR ("traffic_lane_observations"."flow_vehicles_per_hour" IS NOT NULL AND "traffic_lane_observations"."flow_vehicles_per_hour" >= 0)

traffic_observations_value_check.name: traffic_observations_value_check
traffic_observations_value_check.value: ("traffic_observations"."average_speed_kmh" IS NOT NULL AND "traffic_observations"."average_speed_kmh" >= 0) OR ("traffic_observations"."flow_vehicles_per_hour" IS NOT NULL AND "traffic_observations"."flow_vehicles_per_hour" >= 0)

traffic_statistics_import_chunks_values_.name: traffic_statistics_import_chunks_values_check
traffic_statistics_import_chunks_values_.value: "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."resolution" IN ('hour', 'day') AND "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."from_date" <= "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."to_date" AND "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."direction" IN (1, 2) AND "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."volume_row_count" >= 0 AND "traffic_statistics_import_chunks"."speed_row_count" >= 0

traffic_statistics_import_failures_value.name: traffic_statistics_import_failures_values_check
traffic_statistics_import_failures_value.value: "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."resolution" IN ('hour', 'day') AND "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."direction" IN (1, 2) AND "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."metric" IN ('volume', 'speed') AND "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."from_date" <= "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."to_date" AND "traffic_statistics_import_failures"."error_code" IN ('SOURCE_CALCULATION', 'UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE')
